episodes.title: Marcus Hutter | Universal Artificial Intelligence and Solomonoff Induction

screening.publisher_promise: Three-hour whiteboard conversation covering Solomonoff induction, AIXI, the Legg–Hutter intelligence measure and computable approximations.
screening.screening_reason: The originator of AIXI derives a full theory of intelligence from first principles at a whiteboard with a mathematician host. It is the formal counterpart to Chollet in module 1; the book is already in the Compass Library, but the derivation-led conversation is not. Rubric: A originator ✓ · B unifying principle ✓ · C derivation ✓ · D 2 (incomputability; Leike–Hutter critique of the measure) · E 2 · F 2.
screening.transcript_question: Which AIXI results are theorems, which depend on the choice of universal machine, and what survives in computable approximations?

episodes.title: Greg Yang | Large N Limits: Random Matrices & Neural Networks

screening.publisher_promise: Three-hour conversation on large-N limits, random matrices and Tensor Programs.
screening.screening_reason: The originator of Tensor Programs and µP derives which infinite-width limits learn features and which collapse to kernels. It answers a question the repo leaves open: which parametrization makes width a well-behaved scaling axis.
